ALPHA-Dri

ALPHA-Dri bedding is ideal for GLP research. Standard disposable mouse cage bottom arrives pre-bedded and ready for use with ALPHA-Dri. Perfect for GLP studies.

  • M-BTM-AD (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri)
  • M-BTM-ADE (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-ADE-1 (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri with 1-ply Innorichment)

Key Advantages:

  • Dust elimination: Clean and virtually dustless bedding helps reduce cross-contamination, filter clogging, and possible issues of dust adherence to animals.
  • Better for animal observation: Bright, white color aids in animal observation.
  • Exceptional absorbency.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Delivered irradiated.

ALPHA-Dri+

Mouse cage bottom for use with Innovive IVC or static mouse lids, prefilled with ALPHA-Dri+ bedding. ALPHA-Dri+ is both bedding and nesting materials combined in one. Mini-rolls of multi-layered virgin paper cut into short lengths are added to ALPHA-Dri to give the animals nesting material that enhances their nest-building instincts.

  • M-BTM-AD+ (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri+)
  • M-BTM-AD+E1 (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri+ with 1-ply Innorichment)

Key Advantages:

  • Dust elimination: Clean and virtually dustless bedding helps reduce cross-contamination, filter clogging, and possible issues of dust adherence to animals.
  • Better for animal observation: Bright, white color aids in animal observation.
  • Exceptional absorbency.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Delivered irradiated.

Corn Cob

Corn Cob is proven to encapsulate the urea crystals found in animal urine, controlling ammonia levels. Its sponge-like characteristics encapsulate ammonia and trap associated odors.

  • M-BTM-C4 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob)
  • M-BTM-C4E (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C4E-1 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 1-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C8 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob)
  • M-BTM-C8E (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C8E-1 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 1-ply Innorichment)

Key Advantages:

  • Will not cling to animals or cages.
  • Fast-wicking absorption.
  • Resistant to cage flooding from water bottle drip.
  • Perfect for isolator and IVC cages.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Available in 1/4 in (C4) and 1/8 in (C8) sizes.
  • Delivered irradiated.

SAFE (Biofresh)

Mouse cage bottom for use with Innovive IVC or static mouse lids, prefilled with SAFE bedding.

  • M-BTM-EP (Mouse bottom pre-bedded with SAFE)

Key Advantages:

  • Excellent absorbency and ammonia control.
  • Improve the welfare of animals with soft, absorbent, and comfortable bedding.
  • Helps alleviate animals' stress with easier clean-up and longer changeout intervals.
  • Aids in a cleaner and healthier environment for research.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Delivered irradiated.

Reusable

Reusable stainless steel wirebar

Wire bar that protects the water bottle and holds food, for use with a standard rat cage configuration.

Key Advantages:

  • Integrated water bottle protection
  • Food hopper section
  • Stainless steel
  • Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RSX1

Disposable

Disposable plastic feeder

Single-use recyclable plastic feeder with a metal insert and for use with rat water bottle protector (R-WBP) in a standard rat change configuration

Key Advantages:

  • 100% PET
  • BPA-free
  • Recyclable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H, R-BTM-A-H, M-BTM-XL
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RVX5, RSX1

Reusable

Rat water bottle protector

Reusable water bottle protector for use with rat plastic feeder (R-FEED-U) in a standard rat change configuration.

Key Advantages:

  • Protects against water bottle chewing
  • Stainless steel
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H, M-BTM-XL
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RSX1

Reusable

Reusable tall stainless steel wirebar

Wire bar that protects the water bottle and holds food, for use with a tall rat cage configuration.

Key Advantages:

  • Integrated water bottle protection
  • Food hopper section
  • Increased height for tall age profile
  • Stainless steel
  • Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H, R-BTM-XL
  • Compatible lids: RVX7, RVX8, RVX7XL

Reusable

Reusable Tall XL connector

Connector bar used to join two (2) tall rat wirebars (R-WIRE-TD) for Tall Rat XL cage configuration.

Key Advantages:

  • Stainless steel
  • Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-XL
  • Compatible lid: RV7XL

Dual Filter

RVX62

Dual filter IVC rat lid for use in Innorack. It uses two Reemay® filters covering exhaust and supply ports and a Uniblend static filter for enhanced ventilation.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Dual Filter

RVX5

Dual filter IVC. Autowatering. Uses two Reemay® filters and two ventilation grates. Immunocompromised. Standard IVC rodent housing; core facilities, quarantine, remote labs.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Single Filter

RVX6

IVC rat cage lid with large Reemay® filter for active side and Uniblend filter for passive side, external bottle cavity, and large filter area for use with wire bar in Innorack.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with an external water bottle and reusable wire bar.
  • For use with the Innorack IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Static Filter

RSX1

A static rat lid with external bottle cavity and large Unipro® filter area for use in emergency situations.

Key Advantages:

  • For use with external water bottle and reusable wire bar.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Single Filter

RVX7

Tall IVC rat lid with Reemay® and Uniblend filters and external bottle cavity for use with tall wire bar in the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.

Key Advantages:

  • Adds 2" of headroom.
  • Designed to be used with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Dual Filter

RSX8

Tall IVC rat lid with dual Reemay® and Uniblend filters and external bottle cavity for use with tall wire bar in the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.

Key Advantages:

  • Adds 2" of headroom.
  • For use with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat.
  • For use with Innocage® rat bottoms.

Double Wide

RV7XL

Tall Rat XL lid with 2 large Uniblend and Reemay® filter media, allowing an additional 2" of headroom. Made of 100% PET and BPA-free plastic.

Key Advantages:

  • Designed for use with the Innorack Tall IVC Rat XL.
  • For use with Innocage® Rat XL bottom.
